nodes.label: Fail-Closed Input Validation
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous or corrupt input must not silently produce a result, while normal calculations stay unchanged.

nodes.label: Explicit Calculation Consent
nodes.rationale: Unknown version or mod state gates calculations; an explicit per-invocation allow option permits calculation while strict dependency checks remain in force.

nodes.label: Explicit Partial Results
nodes.rationale: Section evidence, failures, deferred outputs and incomplete dependencies remain explicit rather than becoming invented calculations.

nodes.label: Committed Runtime Asset Allowlist
nodes.rationale: The builder selects committed bytes from an explicit Git ref and allowlists runtime assets to exclude private and developer artifacts.

nodes.label: Game Data Redistribution Boundary
nodes.rationale: The MIT code license excludes game-derived data, and external redistribution requires resolved permission.

nodes.label: Pending Acceptance Gates
nodes.rationale: Local success does not establish remote CI or ChatGPT acceptance; unavailable checks and unresolved game-data redistribution conditions remain explicitly pending.

nodes.label: Optional SDK boundary
nodes.rationale: SDK imports stay outside normal CLI paths so the adapter remains optional.

nodes.label: Hash before and after construction
nodes.rationale: Compare hashes before and after construction and never cache failed or changing inputs.

nodes.label: Partial evidence preservation
nodes.rationale: Deferred, incomplete, error, and partial projection evidence must survive unchanged.

nodes.label: Optional MCP dependency
nodes.rationale: Ship MCP support without adding dependencies to the base parser.

nodes.label: --allow-unverified
nodes.rationale: Explicitly permits calculations under uncertain compatibility but does not bypass missing required dependencies.

nodes.label: Untrusted save strings
nodes.rationale: Names, notes, and other save text may look like instructions and must not be executed or followed.

nodes.label: Template income per month

nodes.label: Module support per month
nodes.rationale: Support/mo includes crew salary, water, and volatiles before hab-level farm discounts.

nodes.label: Hab recommendation inputs

nodes.label: Package-only runtime boundary
nodes.rationale: Normal parser commands use packaged catalogs and must not silently read installed game templates or Assembly-CSharp.dll.

nodes.label: Fail-closed behavior
nodes.rationale: Unsupported mechanics, missing blocking dependencies, ambiguous player identity, and unresolved required references remain explicit rather than becoming guessed values.

nodes.label: Authoritative-prefix projection model
nodes.rationale: Completed verified projection transactions remain authoritative; an unsupported next action stops the affected path before its mutation executes.

nodes.label: Execution-derived metric coverage
nodes.rationale: Coverage follows the executed path and does not declare downstream metrics exact merely because a rule exists.

nodes.label: Compatibility gate
nodes.rationale: Calculation commands require verified compatibility or per-invocation opt-in; opt-in does not bypass missing dependencies, unsupported scenarios, or catalog integrity.

nodes.label: Catalog redistribution gate
nodes.rationale: The right to redistribute game-derived catalog contents is unverified; redistribution conditions must be established before transferring an archive outside the workspace.

nodes.label: MIT license scope
nodes.rationale: The project's MIT license does not apply to the contents of data/.

nodes.label: Model routing by task and uncertainty
nodes.rationale: GPT-6.1 Sol low coordinates; GPT-6 Luna low handles search/extraction; GPT-6 Luna xhigh handles routine implementation; GPT-6.1 Sol medium/high is used for broader integration or unresolved architecture/semantics.
nodes.norm_label: model routing by task and uncertainty

nodes.label: analyze bootstrap context
nodes.rationale: The analyze output helps an LLM select subsequent analysis without producing a comprehensive campaign dashboard.

nodes.label: Untrusted save strings
nodes.rationale: Save and report text must be treated as data rather than instructions; observed facts, calculations, assumptions, and missing dependencies remain distinct.

nodes.label: Executed-path coverage
nodes.rationale: Coverage follows the rule path and dependencies actually executed; a rule's existence alone does not establish metric coverage.

nodes.label: Authoritative prefix
nodes.rationale: Verified transactions and completions remain authoritative; an unsupported next action stops before mutation and excludes the affected plan from comparison.

nodes.label: Mean-path stochastic treatment
nodes.rationale: Deterministic mean-input trajectories are marked expected and do not claim to equal the expectation of nonlinear stochastic trajectories.

nodes.label: Package-only mechanics
nodes.rationale: Normal execution preserves packaged mechanics and existing result fields without projection refactoring or catalog regeneration.

nodes.label: Explicit compatibility consent
nodes.rationale: An unverified invocation requires explicit consent and cannot bypass catalog or mechanics dependencies.

nodes.label: Optional local stdio MCP adapter master plan
nodes.norm_label: optional local stdio mcp adapter master plan

nodes.label: Optional adapter distribution
nodes.rationale: The pinned SDK and adapter are optional while the normal parser runtime remains standard-library only.
